Offline comparison report

TUMexchange bar comparison

One current row per university and year, with annual source provenance and a transparent mean. Search by university, country, notes, release, or document.

Interpretation

What the bars mean

This is a normalized historical selection-ratio indicator under a linear bar-width model. A full bar is assigned 100%; half the calibrated width is 50%. “No applications” is explicitly assigned 100%. This is not an individual admission probability and is not a grade-based prediction yet.

Find a university

Assigned 100% means no applications were reported; it is treated as 100% under the explicit project assumption. It is not a measured numeric bar width.
